title: Credit stress: non-accrual share and aggregate fair value to cost

coverage.note: The panel holds 30 of the 32 calendar quarters in the window: 2019Q3 and 2022Q1 are absent and are shown as breaks; no value is interpolated or bridged across them. Non-accrual shares are FV- and cost-weighted, not position counts. The non-accrual series is drawn on 27 of the 30 quarters: 2022Q4, 2023Q4, 2024Q4 carry exactly zero parsed non-accrual flags while their neighbours carry 13 to 22, so they are dropped rather than shown as zero. FV/cost uses all 30 quarters.
